releases.notes:
This is a very minor update, only indicating support for Java 1.21.8. If you’re already using the data pack version of v2.3.0, you don’t need to update.

### Changelog:

**Changes:**

- Updated pack description & file name to include Java 1.21.8

**Technical Changes:**

- [Mod] Now explicitly depends on Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.8
  - Previously, the mod was marked as compatible with 1.21.5 and all future versions, which could cause issues with untested future game updates.

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.8
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5 - 1.21.8
- NeoForge:
  - for 1.21.5: 21.5.74 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 21.6.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 21.7.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.8: 21.8.0 or newer
- Forge:
  - for 1.21.5: 55.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 56.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 57.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.8: 58.0.0 or newer

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Unpackables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack

releases.notes:
### Changelog:

**New Features:**

- Added 1 Melon → 4 Melon Slices recipe
  - Crafting a Melon requires 9 Melon Slices, but breaking a Melon only drops 3–7 Slices (or more with Fortune). I think this is a fair recipe as the Fortune enchantment still has value.

![image](https://i.imgur.com/dDfhcAo.png)

- Added 1 Honeycomb Block → 4 Honeycomb recipe

![image](https://i.imgur.com/foE6Luc.png)

**Changes:**

- Added user platforms to credits.txt

**Technical Changes:**

- Bumped max supported pack format to 80 for Java 1.21.6
- Changed shaped recipes that required a single item slot into shapeless recipes
  - No changes in functionality - everything should still work the same

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.6
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5/1.21.6
- NeoForge:
  - for 1.21.5: 21.5.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 21.6.0 or newer
- Forge:
  - for 1.21.5: 55.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.6: 56.0.0 or newer

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Unpackables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
